As one of Hong Kong’s most iconic landmarks, The Peak is known for its unique charm and unrivalled status as a symbol of the city, making it a favoured filming location for numerous film and television productions.
In
Our Generation
(2025), the two main characters hike up Victoria Peak and wait for daybreak. Standing at the top of the mountain with the city’s nightscape glowing behind her, the heroine Lin Yingtao boldly professes her feelings to Jiang Qiaoxi, creating a romantic scene enhanced by dazzling imagery.
Fulfilling their promise to watch the sunrise together, the couple witnesses the morning light illuminating the city’s skyline and harbour, acting as a testament to their deep bond.
